question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Tedious
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. Exciting .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **Tedious** means something that is dull, monotonous, or tiresome.
 
• The antonym of tedious would be a word that describes something lively, interesting, or engaging.
 
• From the given options:
 
 
• **Option 1 - Dull:** Synonym of tedious, not the correct answer.
 
• **Option 2 - Boring:** Synonym of tedious, not the correct answer.
 
• **Option 3 - Exciting:** The opposite of tedious, correct answer.
 
• **Option 4 - Tiresome:** Synonym of tedious, not the correct answer.
 
 

Correct sentence: *The antonym of tedious is **exciting**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Synonyms of Tedious:** Dull, boring, tiresome, monotonous.
 
• **Antonyms of Tedious:** Exciting, interesting, engaging, stimulating.
 
• **Example Sentence:** The lecture was so tedious that many students fell asleep.
 
• **Antonym Example:** The concert was exciting and kept everyone entertained.
